method: Read all84original Japanese paragraphs162–168 and rendered5lPDF5–6/5kPDF5–6/5dPDF5–7 including photo captions and continuous text. Reconcile narrow concepts against existing field-only supplements before authoring. Existing whole-lesson links are retained only as bounded instructional claims; source-atom completeness is not certified. Nonassigned163/building and167/civil remain pending and receive no new approval in the register.

sourceVisualReview.photosAndCaptions: excavator boom/arm/bucket, steel/tire/vibration rollers, front-loader/dump receiving pair, truck-caption versus rough-terrain-caption inconsistency, crawler crane and tower crane; k6overhead crane/loader/dump/dozer drawings checked as comparators

existingKnowledgeElsewhere.purpose: Rough-terrain identification already explained; shared with civil by existing policy
Overhead crane travel/lifting directions already present; building-specific
Source power-shovel/upward bucket distinction already explained; no duplicate definition

withheldFieldApprovals.reason: Selected5kPDF5–6does not provide the road/tire/vibration roller objectives. Do not import the whole roller lesson from generic compaction or hydraulic-machine overlap. Broader source reverse mapping remains open.
5dPDF7names tower cranes but does not explain mast/floor climbing. A shared machine name does not justify importing the whole climbing lesson. Broader source reverse mapping remains open.

sourceLabelCautions.evidence: Same-style crane image has a truck-crane caption in5lPDF6but rough-terrain caption in5kPDF5/5dPDF7. The k/d body also describes a truck-mounted arrangement. Preserve distinction in existing building049; do not treat captions as universal taxonomy.
5lPDF5/5dPDF6wording could be read as horizontal-only classification. Existing163cluster4already distinguishes vertical/horizontal modes; keep the bounded explanation.

5lPDF6/5kPDF6/5dPDF7list tire-dozer and tire-shovel terms. Existing164already teaches checking model/specification when names differ. Tire-dozer equivalence is not freshly approved for all equipment; no standalone duplicate synonym paragraph authored.

freshPrimaryReferences.scope: Selected body identifies one-cab self-propelled rough-terrain concept. No all-model capacity/ground/operating qualification approval.
Selected model families and material-conditional compaction descriptions; no layer-thickness values imported.

remainingObjectives: Reverse-map every source photo objective to actual original app illustrations; viewing sources alone is not recognition coverage.
Check all nonassigned field objectives and every source number/exception separately; no claim of exhaustive coverage from these84paragraphs.
Tire-dozer terminology requires product/context-specific verification before becoming an unconditional equivalence.
